description: Build a 15-second video ad kit from a business's web page: its homepage, a product page, a restaurant's site. It takes two calls, because the user's email address has to be proved first. Call it with url and email: a code is emailed to the user. Ask them for the code, then call it again with url, email and code: that returns an id and a page the user can open to watch the build. The ad takes about five minutes, so follow it with get_ad; the user is also emailed when it is ready.

code.description: The code Pagecuts emailed to that address. Leave it out on the first call.

email.description: The user's own email address. Ask for it; never guess it.

instructions.description: Optional. What this ad should push, in the user's words: an offer, a product, an event, who it is for. Up to 2,000 characters.

url.description: The page the ad should send people to.

name: make_ad
title: Make an ad from a web page
